purpose: Document Samalut cadastral/mapping custody discovery and bounded anonymous official-service checks without treating unavailable or non-parcel responses as citywide absence.
assessment: Egypt has an official national cadastral/mapping custodian in the Egyptian Survey Authority, and an official national ArcGIS service was reachable. The inspected ArcGIS service exposes Building/CITY/CENTER/STATE/Equipments rather than parcels; a bounded Building query returned an ArcGIS 400 error. No Samalut parcel response, safe native parcel identity, parcel schema, CRS, or citywide open coverage was verified. registryFound remains null because no city/local parcel registry, cadastral map, or procedure specifically evidencing Samalut was established; general national-agency prose is not local custody evidence. Runtime readiness remains held.

Retrieved Building layer metadata; it is polygon geometry but not a cadastral parcel layer. No source fields were retained.
Issued one bounded anonymous geometry query around the unchanged WUP point against the official Building layer with outFields=OBJECTID and returnGeometry=true; HTTP 200 contained an ArcGIS error 400.
